title: MCP Focus/Workspace Receipt
description: Privacy-safe receipt for focus-safe interactive GUI MCP launches (AM-0006). Window ids and active-window identities are persisted hashed; raw window titles are never stored. Required before/after facts prove the owner's current workspace and active window were preserved and that the provider window was placed on the originating OpenCode session's workspace without activating or switching desktops.

providerNonIconic.description: Post-move proof that the provider window is visible and not iconic (WM_STATE). Null when the provider window was never attributed.

otherWindowsUnchanged.description: Post-move proof that no other window changed workspace during the launch/move. Null when not verifiable.

placement.description: prevented_and_verified: no race-window violation and all post-move proofs hold. detected_after_violation: the provider (or an unattributable actor) changed the current desktop or stole the active window during the launch race window; the run exits non-zero. blocked_before_launch: headed placement safety was not established, so the provider was never launched. verification_failed: launched but post-move proof failed (wrong workspace, iconic, other windows moved). no-new-window-detected / needs-user / blocked / unobservable: honest fallbacks.
